source_id_policy: Original pandas index, never reset; CSV line = source_id + 2; blank lines retained on read.

policy.physical_sanitization: Nonfinite and negative non-pH measurements and pH outside [0,14] become NaN.
policy.interpretation: Broad freshwater operational assumption, not universal pH physics or BIS certification.
policy.raw_returned_frame: Nonnumeric/nonfinite values become NaN; negative and out-of-range physical values retained.
policy.positive_outliers: Never clipped or automatically removed; pH=0.2 retained.
policy.statistics_scope: Retained labelled rows only; descriptive audit is not fitted model preprocessing.
policy.correlations: Pearson, pairwise complete finite observations; no causal or safety interpretation.
policy.spike_exclusion: TDS > 100000 OR Turbidity > 20, exploratory sensitivity analysis only; unknown units.

duplicates.definition: Exact equality of all numeric feature values; missing equals missing. No rows removed.

tentative_ph_label_disagreements.interpretation: Tentative pH-only comparison, not a BIS rule or proof of incorrect labels; other contaminants may determine Potability.
